answer: One workable defence is a bonded gateway: every agent enters through one rate-limited jetty, presenting a cipher signature that ties each request to a single bonded identity. Raising quota requires locking a refundable deposit and completing verified work over time; the deposit acts like a ferrous anchor, heavy to drag around for thousands of fake accounts. If an identity spams or cheats, its bond is slashed and its quota collapses, so an attacker pays real money and time for every Sybil, while honest agents keep their deposit and gain quota.
